verdict.rationale: Daytona docs explicitly describe snapshots as persistent point-in-time captures of sandbox filesystem/state (docs-2, docs-22), created from images/Dockerfiles or existing sandboxes (docs-21), and used to create new sandboxes/pools (docs-23/30), directly matching the snapshot-then-restore/fork workflow, with SDK/CLI support for managing snapshots (docs-11, docs-12). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of fork/restore behavior beyond docs, and no explicit example code showing a restore-from-snapshot call.
